title: Contrast and development
subtitle: Read ἀλλά, καί, and δέ as paragraph moves.
overview: Small connectives create an argument’s texture: ἀλλά can correct or contrast, δέ can advance or contrast, and καί can add, sequence, or intensify.
Avoid using one fixed English equivalent. State the relationship between the two units before translating the particle.

items.grc: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν υἱὸν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἵνα κρίνῃ τὸν κόσμον, ἀλλ᾽ ἵνα σωθῇ ὁ κόσμος δι᾽ αὐτοῦ.
items.en: For God did not send the Son into the world to judge the world, but so that the world might be saved through him.

items.grc: καὶ ἦν διδάσκων καὶ κηρύσσων τὸ εὐαγγέλιον.
items.en: And he was teaching and proclaiming the gospel.
